note: Scoped down from the plan's aspirational '>=40 held-out seeds across >=4 families' target given real session time constraints. 21 total seeds across 7 families, each hand-authored (or, for wall_planter, taken from the pre-existing audited ladder) and adversarially reviewed for ground-truth correctness. Documented honestly rather than padded: statistical power at this N is limited and the final report says so explicitly.

train.description: low+medium tier seeds from train-role families, used by optimize.py's beam search

heldout_same_family.description: high tier of the same 4 train families, never seen by the optimizer, used in the final paired harness run

heldout_family.description: 3 families never touched during training at all (any tier) — the true generalization check. enclosure is the primary one per the architecture's key risk finding (mechanical/functional parts are the domain with no prior evidence for the depth-policy design); coaster and desk_organizer_tray extend the check to decorative objects the optimizer also never saw.
